references.text: The command to tell children about God's deeds in Egypt, especially connected with the Passover celebration and how the Lord struck down the Egyptians.
Moses instructs the people to tell their children about the exodus from Egypt, and that this should serve as a sign on the hand.
The exhortation to explain to your children in the future what the Lord did when he brought the people out of Egypt.
A reminder to remember and pass on to children and grandchildren what they saw at Horeb.
When children ask about the laws, they are to hear about the Lord's signs and wonders in Egypt.
The psalmist describes the tradition of telling the Lord's deeds to future generations so that they may know them.
A description of the signs and wonders God performed in Egypt through Moses and Aaron.
An encouragement to tell the Lord's deeds to children and grandchildren through the generations.
Paul quotes about Pharaoh and how God showed his power through him so that his name would be proclaimed throughout the earth.
